diagnostics.label: await non-async expression
causes: RSScript does not expose Future or Task values in source; the executable async MVP only awaits direct async calls.

fixes.title: Await an `async fn` call directly.

diagnostics.label: value live across await
causes: Suspending an RSScript async frame may keep managed handles and Copy snapshots, but local values, resources, and runtime guards must not be retained across suspension.

fixes.title: End the lifetime of `sender` before this `await`.
